environment: Actual production logic and WebGL renderer. Only imports/assets rebased to local blob URLs; Chromium SwiftShader/Xvfb. Mouse/key events and emulated touch, not physical iPhone/Safari. Route steering scripted, supply collection and gum-to-mouth/bubble gestures use real controls. Combat screenshots use controlled scenes.
